description: This Dart file defines the MockLessonsRepository class, which provides mock data and methods to retrieve lessons for testing or development purposes in a learning app. It includes methods to get all lessons and to get a lesson by ID, along with sample lesson data.

classes.name: MockLessonsRepository
classes.description: A class providing mock lesson data with methods to retrieve lessons and lessons by ID.

methods.name: getLessons
methods.description: Returns a Future resolving to the list of sample lessons.

methods.name: getLessonById
methods.description: Returns a Future resolving to a lesson matching the provided ID, or the first lesson if not found.
